patch.value: Keep dependency bullets when a closed item covers a release window

Review-thread follow-up from the 2026-11-14 sweep PR rebase: the pinned pm-changelog generator renders the git-derived Dependencies section only for windows without closed tracker items, so evidenced closures covering a window replace its published dependency bullets. Consider opting the changelog generation into dependency-updates rendering so published dependency entries survive alongside item notes.
A decision records whether changelog:full should render git-derived dependency bullets alongside item-covered windows; any script change regenerates and checks the changelog and passes release gates
